question: Will Candidate A win the 2026 gubernatorial election in State X?
description: This market resolves based on the officially certified result of the November 2026 gubernatorial election in State X.
resolutionRules: Resolves YES if Candidate A is officially certified as the winner by the State X electoral authority. Resolves NO if any other candidate is certified. If the election is postponed beyond December 31, 2026, the market resolves NO.
